headline: Mickey Factz gives Conway The Machine his flowers as this week’s Lyricist of the Week. Con
body: Mickey Factz gives Conway The Machine his flowers as this week’s Lyricist of the Week. Conway’s new album, OTIS, released on Nov. 20 with 11 tracks and features from Ghostface Killah, Raekwon, Method Man, Kool G Rap and Flee Lord. Mickey salutes Conway for continuing to elevate his game.
rendered_body_text: Mickey Factz gives Conway The Machine his flowers as this week’s Lyricist of the Week. Conway’s new album, OTIS, released on Nov. 20 with 11 tracks and features from Ghostface Killah, Raekwon, Method Man, Kool G Rap and Flee Lord. Mickey salutes Conway for continuing to elevate his game.
